Name: HUD Message Position
Author: Wooa404
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Customize your Stardew Valley HUD to suit your preferences!
HUD Message Position lets you move HUD messages, notifications, and UI Info Suite 2 experience bars to your preferred positions.
Arrange your HUD elements the way you like and enjoy a more comfortable gameplay experience.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod[/*]
[*]Place the [u]HUDMessagePosition [/u]folder into your Stardew Valley [u]Mods[/u] folder.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Customizable HUD positions: Move HUD messages and notifications to your preferred locations.[/*]
[*]UI Info Suite 2 support: Customize the position of experience bars when UI Info Suite 2 is installed.[/*]
[*]Adjustable spacing: Arrange supported HUD elements with customizable spacing.[/*]
[*]Optional integration: The mod works without UI Info Suite 2.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]UI Info Suite 2 — Required only for experience bar positioning.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#fafafa][size=4]Shou[/size][/color][color=#fafafa][size=4]t Outs[/size][/color]
Special thanks to the creators of SMAPI and UI Info Suite 2 for their amazing work and contributions to the Stardew Valley modding community.
And thank you to everyone who gives this little mod a try! ♡

— Wooa404
